title: Introduction to Expo Build
overview: Expo provides tools to create production-ready builds of mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms.

example.title: Build Process
example.content:
Source Code
 ↓
Expo Build Service
 ↓
Android APK/AAB or iOS IPA

title: EAS Build Introduction
overview: EAS Build is Expo's cloud service used to create application binaries for Android and iOS.

example.title: EAS Build Command
example.content:
eas build --platform android

eas build --platform ios

title: Android Build Types
overview: Android applications can be built in different formats depending on testing and store distribution requirements.

example.content:
APK:
Testing purpose

AAB:

title: iOS Build Process
overview: Expo allows developers to create iOS builds using EAS without manually managing native build configurations.

example.title: iOS Build
example.content:
Expo Project
 ↓

IPA File

title: App Configuration Before Build
overview: Before creating builds, application information like name, icon, version, permissions, and identifiers must be configured.

name
version

title: Testing Production Builds
overview: Production builds should be tested on real devices before publishing to application stores.

example.content:

title: Publishing Applications
overview: Expo applications can be published to Google Play Store and Apple App Store after completing build and testing steps.
